help.de: Free, anonymous advice for workers from other EU countries, including seasonal farmworkers. Free 0800 hotlines in each language are listed on the advice page. Some workers from outside the EU can also get help.
help.di: Nasihat gratis dan anonim bagi pekerja dari negara Uni Eropa lain, termasuk pekerja musiman pertanian. Nomor bebas pulsa 0800 untuk tiap bahasa tercantum di halaman layanan. Sebagian pekerja dari luar Uni Eropa juga…
